candidate_sentences.text: AS Silvano Fashion Group’s unaudited revenue for the six months ended 30 June 2026 was EUR 28.590 million, up 0.6% from EUR 28.428 million in the same period of 2025.

Despite the stronger gross profit, operating profit decreased 3.5% to EUR 5.751 million, with the operating margin declining to 20.1% from 21.0%.
As a result, consolidated net profit declined 31.2% to EUR 4.321 million.
